endpoints./operators: List of operators and their basic infos
endpoints./operators/{id}: Detailed infos about a given operator
endpoints./operators/{id}/trait/{phase}: Trait of the operator at a given elite level
endpoints./operators/{id}/talent/{number}/{phase}/: Talent of the operator at a given elite level and potential
endpoints./operators/{id}/potential/{rank}: bonus given by a given potential rank
endpoints./operators/{id}/phases/{number}: Infos about the given elite level
endpoints./operators/{id}/phases/{number}/stats/{l: Stats of the operator at any given level
endpoints./operators/{id}/favor: The trust bonus of the operator
endpoints./operators/{id}/skills/{number}/{level}: Infos about a given level of a skill
endpoints./operators/{id}/full: All of the above at the same time (except skills)
endpoints./skills/{id}/{level}: Details of a given skill level
endpoints./modules/{id}/{level}: Details of a given module level
